body.p: Zakhar and a reindeer. The Mansi in the North of Urals have a favourite lake, called Vatkatur. Not far from this lake, there lived a hunter in his tent with his children. His name was Zakhar. He was a very hard-working man. All day long he walked around the forest hunting. He knew all the animals, he always found bear pits in winter. But he had never caught reindeer. Zakhar feels sorry for the reindeer, he always looks at them. One day Zakhar went to watch his nets. It was in the summer. The night fell. He turned off the road and went to the lake. The soil is bad near the lake. Zakhar is walking, he is jumping from bump to bump. There are a lot of cloudberries around. Blueberries and cowberries are growing here, it is so good here. Only mosquitoes cry, but Zakhar is used to it and he does not notice it. Suddenly Zakhar saw: in many places, the moss had been torn out by the roots. He took a good look and said: âThis animal followed the footprint here today.â. The lake is so good. One can only hear the fish splashing, and the seagulls flying. Zakhar is sitting in the boat, he wants to see his nets. Suddenly he saw a beautiful animal standing not far from him. A reindeer. While Zakhar was thinking, the oars fell from his hands. The deer jumped up, stood for a while, raised its head up, and there was a small black spot on its forehead. He immediately ran away. Zakhar looked at the reindeer and immediately started to work. Walking home, Zakhar kept thinking about the reindeer. Summer has passed, autumn has come. Autumn has passed, winter has come. Winter in the Urals is cold, there is a lot of snow. It is hard for Zakhar to live with his family. The tent has become very bad. And he does not get any prey. âAnimals have gone far away, or I do not hunt well,â - thinks Zakhar. He went into the forest again. There is nothing for a day, there is nothing the other day, then his strength ran out. He can't find a trace of animals. The day was cold, his clothes got icy. He got tired and wanted to sleep. He came out of the forest, and then a big storm happened. He sees a herd of reindeer at the edge of the forest. Reindeer are eating. With them is the reindeer he saw when he was checking the nets. On his forehead, he has a small black spot.[ShA:] MÉdisobuÊujza is an unexpected form, mÉdipuÊujza is expected. Zakhar slowly went to the reindeer. He came very close to the reindeer. He would have killed the reindeer, but his heart trembled, he did not want to kill the reindeer, he felt sorry for it. Then the reindeer heard that there was a man nearby. When Zakhar came out of the forest, they ran away. His strength ran out. He wanted to go back, but when suddenly he saw that a huge strong reindeer was walking towards him, with his head down. Zakhar got frightened and hid in the forest. The reindeer stopped near Zakhar and said to Zakhar in a human language: "Hello, Zakhar, the hunter.â. Zakhar got scared and sat down on the ground. And the reindeer said: âI have known you for a long time, I see how you work. You walk along the forest and do not kill animals. Zakhar said: "Thank you, good reindeer, you have taken me with your good words." The reindeer said: "Be here again tomorrow." It raised his head high and ran. All night long Zakhar was thinking a lot about how the reindeer talked to him. The first sun has already appeared. Zakhar came again to the same place. The good reindeer is waiting for the man. It saw the tired Zakhar and said:âI will be a good friend to you, I will help you.â. The deer ran quickly along the forest. Not a single twig moved, not a single snowflake fell. He came home in joy. The days go by quickly. Everyone is used to the good reindeer, Zakhar started to live well. The reindeer does all the hard work by itself.[ShA:] The syntax of ÄukÄi tÉxoÉÊ sÉjza te is rather strange. The hunter thought how could he pay back to the good reindeer. It did all the hard work. He thought to make such antlers, that no one else has. For a long time in the evenings, they sit with the whole family making twigs. They made strong horns, horns with many branches, beautiful. In the spring, when the snow melted, the forest was full of animals and wolves. One day Zakhar came out of the tent. He harnessed the reindeer, he put the children and his wife on the sledge. âLet's go,â -â Zakhar shouts. They raced through the forest. Here is the lake Vatkatur. At that time the lake was very beautiful, the ducks flew one after another. Missing their land, they shouted and bathed. Zakhar released the reindeer and led him to the place where he had seen him for the first time. Zakhar's eldest son brought the antlers they made to the reindeer. âHere are beautiful antlers for you, reindeer,â â Zakhar said. "Thank you, you have helped me a lot, go, run." The reindeer shakes his head, and walks, and the earth turns under his antlers. "Thank you too, man. With such antlers, I am not afraid even of a wolf,â â said the reindeer. It shook its beautiful antlers and went into the forest. They say that starting from these ancient days, reindeer have antlers and they live together with Enets people.
